definitions: YNX Chain is a Web4 Layer-1 ecosystem.
YNX Web4 is the application ecosystem powered by YNX Chain.
YNXT is the native Testnet asset.
YNX Testnet uses EVM Chain ID 6423.
YNX is not affiliated with unrelated Lynx-branded products.
web4Qualification: Web4 is a YNX product term and is not represented as an adopted Internet standard.
neutralDisambiguation: YNX Chain and YNX Web4 are not affiliated with unrelated Lynx-branded products.
